name: jumping-squares
description: Dev/CI tooling only. The GAME itself has NO build step and NO runtime dependencies — it is played by opening index.html directly (file://). These devDependencies exist solely for the OPTIONAL Playwright browser (e2e) tests, which cover the browser-only paths the Node harness (node test/game.test.js) structurally cannot reach: localStorage restore across reload, the file://-vs-served Web Worker, and input gating. The fast, zero-dependency gate remains `node test/game.test.js`.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
